datasets.title: Daily weather at Boston Logan Airport since 1936 (GHCN-Daily)
datasets.description: NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network daily observations for station USW00014739: precipitation, snowfall, snow depth, maximum and minimum temperature and other elements, each with its measurement, quality and source flags. One row per day, 1 January 1936 to 29 September 2026. Dataset version 3.35-upd-2026100617; cite Menne et al. (2012), see README.
datasets.coverage: Daily, 1936-01-01 to 2026-09-29 · one station: Boston Logan International Airport
